turns.question: What was the ratio of non-cancelled order revenue to total ad spend in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-ad-euro (revenue-to-ad-spend ratio) metric, so I won't compute one; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) at 12,582.75 EUR and Ad spend (EUR) at 6,270.00 EUR for 1-30 September 2026.
